_note: Orders of magnitude from public sources (accessed 2026-11-01); items marked 'assumed' have no public source and are declared as assumptions in the paper.

expedition._src: Fincantieri fact sheet, Le Laperouse: 92 passenger cabins, 72 crew cabins

midsize._src: Fincantieri fact sheet, 47,842 GT ship delivered 2015: 473 passenger cabins, 265 crew cabins

large._src: Fincantieri fact sheet, 99,863 GT ship delivered 2016: 1,331 passenger cabins, 588 crew cabins

very_large._src: Oasis class (Wikipedia): 2,744 passenger cabins, 1,197 crew cabins

cruiseferry._src: MS Color Magic (Wikipedia): 1,016 cabins; crew cabins assumed

_units_rule: assumed: public-area drivers 1.4 per passenger cabin (about 8,000 public lamps for 1,150 cabins, eeNews 2011, at roughly 5 lamps per driver); exterior drivers 0.2, galley supplies 0.05 per passenger cabin; technical drives 0.03 per cabin

cabin_led_driver._src: Mean Well LPV-60, Telcordia SR-332 MTBF 5188.4K h; drivers per cabin assumed

cabin_usb_psu._src: proxy: Mean Well IRM-10 module, Telcordia MTBF 9094.9K h

fancoil_ec_drive._src: proxy: Schneider Altivar 212 0.75-2.2 kW, IEC 62380 MTTF 560000 h; one fan-coil per cabin (Danfoss, Heinen & Hopman)

public_led_driver._src: Mean Well ELG-150-C, Telcordia MTBF 2661.6K h

galley_smps._src: Mean Well LRS-150, Telcordia MTBF 2707.7K h

exterior_led_driver._src: Mean Well HLG-100H (IP67), Telcordia MTBF 2185.8K h

technical_vfd._src: Schneider Altivar 212 3-7.5 kW, IEC 62380 MTTF 540000 h

_zone_temp_src: assumed interior set points; technical spaces below the 40-45 C design ambient of 46 CFR 111.01-15 and IEC 60092-306
_regions_src: 1991-2020 January and July daily means: Nassau, Barcelona (AEMET), Bergen (Seklima), Juneau (NOAA, July only; Alaska is a summer region)
_durations_src: CLIA 2025: worldwide average cruise length 7.0 days; distribution assumed
_occupancy_src: occupancy of 100-105 % on a two-per-cabin basis (10-K FY2024); share of cabins occupied assumed
_ea_src: MIL-HDBK-217F microcircuits 0.35-0.65 eV; FIDES 0.7 eV; discretes 0.17-0.27 eV
_field_src: Siemens RUGGEDCOM 'MTBF Methods' (2015): Ground Benign 25 C vs Naval Sheltered 55 C differ by 2.5-4x
_shock_src: EMSA Annual Overview 2025: about 0.05 reported loss-of-propulsion events per passenger ship-year, a lower bound given under-reporting; 0.05-0.5 explored
_lot_src: order of the Halifax 2019 driver episode (2.3 % per year against a quoted 1-2 %); assumed
